name: Automated Orbital Defense System
desc: An Automated Network of Independent Orbital Defense Platforms, ranging from small to moderate in size. They are capable of fending off enemy fleet to certain degree while fortifying the ground defense, thereby making sure it would be extremely difficult to carry out raiding operations.

name: Arc Light Bureau HQ
desc: The core institution of the Arc Light Bureau, its cloud-piercing complex houses countless scientists and engineers who direct the Bureau's research and development.

name: Automated Fleet Command Center
desc: The Center of the Automated Fleet, responsible for the development of Project "Skydome Bastion" and the command of the massive automated defense fleet, maintaining the safety of Design Bureau at all times.
